messages:
Nina: quick thread — Skyline Data case study timeline. goal: publish next Thurs 9am PT, include webinar CTA for Apr 30. need approved quote, 2 social cards, and HubSpot routing. who can lead?

Carlos: I can run ops. booked a follow-up sign-off call w/ Skyline PM Wed 2pm PT to confirm quote wording.

Bea: Ill finish the hero copy and social snippets. can someone confirm final metrics?

Mark: Metrics confirmed: p95 latency from 360ms -> 110ms (~3.3x) and steady-state serving cost down 31%. sheet: <https://docs.redwood/internal/skyline-metrics-2112>.

Nina: perfect. Bea draft hero + 3 social variants by EOD Tue. Carlos, add recorder link to the content checklist and attach transcript after call. use our template: <https://drive.redwood/internal/templates/case-interview>.

Carlos: checklist updated: <https://drive.redwood/internal/checklists/skyline-2112>. recorder link in doc. scheduling CMS draft for Thurs 9am PT pending legal.

Bea: rough hero: "Skyline Data reduced p95 latency ~3.3x and cut serving costs by 31% with Redwood, freeing up infra budget for product experiments." refining now.

Nina: avoid "cut" per style guide; use "reduced". also add webinar CTA: "Join our Apr 30 webinar for a performance deep-dive."

Bea: updated: "Skyline Data reduced p95 latency ~3.3x and reduced serving costs by 31% with Redwood, freeing infra budget for product experiments. Join our Apr 30 webinar for a performance deep-dive."

Carlos: legal heads-up  submit quote & use approval form: <https://legal.redwood/submit?case=skyline-2112>. LegalBot: please run check for name usage + metric phrasing.

LegalBot: received. Please attach customer consent doc. ETA review 24-48h.

Mark: customer consent uploaded to the form. also asked Skyline to confirm exact phrasing on the ~3.3x callout.

Bea: proposed hero quote for approval: "Redwood helped Skyline Data reduce p95 latency by ~3x and lower serving costs by 31%, which unlocked faster product iteration."

Carlos: added UTM params and HubSpot mapping: ?utm_source=marketing&utm_campaign=skyline_case&utm_medium=post. HubSpot flow name: skyline_case_flow. hooking AE webhook to #ae-alerts.

SalesOpsBot: HubSpot workflow created: skyline_case_flow. AE webhook test delivered. Also created lead mapping: lead.source=skyline_case; tag=webinar_skyline.

LegalBot: approved with two edits: replace "our" with company name where present; avoid "~3x" in headline (use "about 3x"). Uploaded approval: <https://legal.redwood/approvals/skyline-2112/approved.pdf>.

Nina: noted. Bea, switch to "about 3x" in headline and update CMS. Carlos, once legal artifact is attached we'll flip to publish.

Bea: updated hero + social variants in CMS draft: <https://cms.redwood/drafts/skyline-2112>. images uploaded to drive: <https://drive.redwood/content/skyline-assets>.

Carlos: smoke test on HubSpot flow passes. test lead created with UTM and landed in AE queue. Slack webhook posts lead summary to #ae-alerts.

Mark: confirmed Skyline PM signed off on final quote during Wed call. they requested one small tweak to the quote (changed "lower" to "reduce").

Bea: tweak applied. final quote: "Redwood helped Skyline Data reduce p95 latency by about 3x and reduce serving costs by 31%, which unlocked faster product iteration." submitted final to LegalBot for record.

LegalBot: final approval archived. approval link: <https://legal.redwood/approvals/skyline-2112/final.pdf>.

Nina: timeline looks good. Carlos please schedule publish for Thurs 9am PT and confirm Buffer/CMS publish. SalesOpsBot keep the AE webhook live for 72h post-publish.

Carlos: scheduled in CMS for Thu 09:00 PT, Buffer queued for social. Buffer post includes UTM + webinar CTA. Slack AE ping live on publish.

SalesOpsBot: AE webhook will remain active for 72h. created report to track inbound demo conversions from skyline_case.

Bea: final assets & copy uploaded: <https://drive.redwood/content/skyline-final-assets>. social variations ready.

Mark: quick prod note: monitor demo queue for any spikes; set 15-min paging if >10 leads/min.

Nina: thanks team  great work. Ill post announce in #general once live and close this thread. :tada:
